description_en: Queries the trend of cross-border transfer of personal information data
description_zh: 查询个人信息数据出境走势
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sensitive-outbound-trend --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSensitiveOutboundTrend

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.
Compliance review currently supports querying data only for the last 1 month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months, or from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure the time range is valid
parameters.help_zh:
查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据，请确保时间的合法性
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

Compliance review currently supports querying data only for the last 1 month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months, or from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure the time range is valid
parameters.help_zh:
查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。

合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据，请确保时间的合法性
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The hybrid cloud cluster ID.
This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Data.description_en: The list of cross-border data transfer information

InfoCount.description_en: The total number of personal information records

InfoOutboundCount.description_en: The total number of personal information records transferred cross-border

SensitiveOutboundCount.description_en: The total number of sensitive information records transferred cross-border

Timestamp.description_en: The time of the cross-border data transfer. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 数据出境时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
